To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
* We have developed and implemented a new query optimization algorithm for web-databases that is based on the notion of user preferences.

1) the proposed quality contract model can be used to express the preferences of users and the system; 2) the proposed quality model is effective and efficient in optimizing towards user preferences and system goals; 3) the proposed quality contracts provide the necessary flexibility for the system to gracefully handle different workloads and to achieve better quality of service.

(a) the system should be able to manage query/update transactions under quality contracts, (b) the system should support user preferences and optimize towards them, and (c) the system should provide users with a way to monitor the progress of transactions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing new techniques for managing query and update transactions in web-databases under user-specified quality-of-service (QoS) requirements.
